name: maxsurf-mcp
description: Local, guarded COM tools for Maxsurf Modeler, Stability, Resistance, Motions and Multiframe.
long_description: Release candidate. Requires separately installed and licensed Maxsurf and Windows x64 CPython 3.12. Includes MCP source and dependencies, not Bentley software or manuals. Live release acceptance is recorded in docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md. Original project code and assets are MIT licensed. Copyright (c) 2026 Ismail Hakki Celik.

python_path.title: Python 3.12 x64 executable
python_path.description: Select a trusted 64-bit CPython 3.12 python.exe. The bundle includes dependencies; no project checkout or virtual environment is required.

workspace.title: Design workspace
workspace.description: Only designs/exports inside this folder are accessible to normal file tools. Use a dedicated folder, not the whole drive.
